Freemius was rendered on 7.9 (freemius-rail.md:328-378; REJECTED.md:1344-1385), and Polar was read in channel-loop tick 3 on 28.9 (polar-rail.md:62-69; BOARD-LOOP.md:143-148). Whop's Israel payout comes from the clipping sweep (REJECTED.md:1057-1058). Not swept before: Podia, Sellix, Creem, Dodo Payments. NEW today, all github grade at antiwork/gumroad commit f6b82fbe unless noted: (1) Gumroad's own API docs (ApiDocumentation/Endpoints/Products.tsx) document POST /v2/products. That settles the code-versus-FAQ conflict in favour of product creation by API; a live runner run (AT-15) is still the proof. (2) Every alive Gumroad product goes into gumroad.com's product sitemap (sitemap_service.rb: Link.alive.where(created_at: period), then pings search engines) whether or not it has sold, and product pages are noindexed only when not alive. (3) The Discover gate still holds: recommendations.rb has sale_made, and searchable.rb has must term is_recommendable:true. (4) Polar fails the camera gate. Its own server code sets require_live_capture:true and require_matching_selfie:true (Stripe Identity), and its docs say the owner verifies 'along with a selfie'. (5) Whop fails the camera gate. Its official SDK requires a 'Photo of the person's face… Always required, with every document type' before payout. (6) Lemon Squeezy's official SDK can only list and get products; it has no create call. ANSWER TO THE QUESTION: Gumroad is the only rail that passes both gates at github grade. It creates products by API, pays ILS to an Israeli bank, and has no selfie field anywhere in its code. It also rides owner step 3, which is already on the seven-step list. Freemius passes the payout and no-camera gates (rendered) and has a creation API (github), but it takes software only, and its production verification is per product with UNKNOWN owner work. No venue in this family brings buyers to a new listing before that listing's first sale.

candidates.estimate_basis: INFERENCE. Anchor: the audited single Gumroad line is ₪250/month gross at month 12 with ₪0 in months 1-3 (REJECTED.md:657). The committed il-biz-tools (₪400) and pcn874 (₪600) lines are ceilings (REJECTED.md:1294-1296), and FORECAST.md treats il-biz-tools as ₪0 likely. Breadth multiplies how many products can catch a first sale, not demand. Low: no product ever gets an outside first sale; no stranger buyer has been measured on any line (FORECAST.md assumptions). High: about 4-5 products each reaching the audited ₪250 band, with Discover adding only after each product's own first sale, at a 30% fee. Figures are gross, before the ~22% small-ticket take (rails.ts:81). Risk: flooding one brand invites spam-cluster action (FORECAST.md), so the inventory stays capped.
candidates.time_to_first_sale: Not before owner step 3 (FORECAST calendars the steps around 11.10.2026) and a first outside buyer, realistically 1-3 months after that, possibly never. Discover opens per product only after that product's first sale. Gumroad reviews the seller for 1-3 weeks after the first 3-4 sales, and the payout minimum is $100.
